svg.title: A Harness Around Claude
svg.desc: An agent harness for a returns assistant with a turn cap and a hook that blocks refunds over the cap, shown beside self-hosted and Anthropic-hosted deployment, where the difference is who runs the loop and the sandbox.
svg.text: Fernwick Retail: the hook, not the prompt, stops a refund over the cap.
PreToolUse on issue_refund; 180 is over the cap of 150, so permissionDecision is deny
Runs the tool only when no hook denied it
The result goes back to Claude; max_turns=12 ends a runaway loop
WHO RUNS THE LOOP AND THE SANDBOX?
Your process runs the loop, hooks and tools; you
Anthropic runs the loop in a managed sandbox
